name: lifesim
description: LifeSim — a Sims-inspired life simulation (Tauri + TypeScript)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @lifesim/shared && npm run build -w @lifesim/content && npm run build -w @lifesim/sim && npm run build -w @lifesim/render && npm run build -w @lifesim/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lifesim/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lifesim/sim && npm run typecheck -w @lifesim/content && npm run typecheck -w @lifesim/render && npm run typecheck -w @lifesim/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lifesim/shared && npm run test -w @lifesim/sim && npm run test -w @lifesim/content
